title: GST paid on the spot? Refund it

scenes.dialogue: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. Tax paid on the spot in a surprise G S T inspection, and never acknowledged. Can the department simply keep it?
On the twenty eighth of October, twenty twenty six, a single bench of Honourable Justice N Senthilkumar of the Madras High Court ruled.
scenes.shown: On 28 October 2026, a single bench of Honourable Justice N. Senthilkumar of the Madras High Court ruled.

scenes.dialogue: Aruna Mills, a yarn maker in Tiruppur, faced a surprise G S T inspection in October twenty twenty three, on the days of a family wedding.
scenes.shown: Aruna Mills, a yarn maker in Tiruppur, faced a surprise GST inspection in October 2023, on the days of a family wedding.

scenes.dialogue: The firm says over two crore rupees of tax was collected on the spot, through Form D R C zero three, and was not voluntary. It sought a refund.
scenes.shown: The firm says over ₹2 crore of tax was collected on the spot, through Form DRC-03, and was not voluntary. It sought a refund.

scenes.dialogue: The officer passed orders in Form D R C zero five in March twenty twenty four. But no acknowledgement in Form D R C zero four was ever issued.
scenes.shown: The officer passed orders in Form DRC-05 in March 2024. But no acknowledgement in Form DRC-04 was ever issued.

scenes.dialogue: The department's answer: Form D R C zero three is voluntary, payment needs an O T P sent only to the partners, and the protest came seventeen days late.
scenes.shown: The department's answer: Form DRC-03 is voluntary, payment needs an OTP sent only to the partners, and the protest came 17 days late.

scenes.dialogue: The Court found the inspection fell on the wedding days, so the partners could not be present. And the seventeen day delay could not, by itself, defeat the claim.
scenes.shown: The Court found the inspection fell on the wedding days, so the partners could not be present. And the 17-day delay could not, by itself, defeat the claim.

scenes.dialogue: The respondents' own counter showed Form D R C zero four was never issued, and the firm's protest was not considered. The missing form was fatal, the Court held.
scenes.shown: The respondents' own counter showed Form DRC-04 was never issued, and the firm's protest was not considered. The missing form was fatal, the Court held.

scenes.dialogue: So the March twenty twenty four orders were set aside. The tax paid during the inspection must be refunded within eight weeks, and the writ petitions were allowed.
scenes.shown: So the March 2024 orders were set aside. The tax paid during the inspection must be refunded within 8 weeks, and the writ petitions were allowed.
